children: HC Wainwright & Co. reiterated their Buy rating on LifeMD's stock with a price target of $9.00.
The price target implies an upside of 180.4% from the Sep 16 close of $3.21.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: LifeMD's collaboration with AT&T provides eligible customers with complimentary access to its telehealth services, potentially expanding its user base significantly by tapping into AT&T's 100 million customers. This partnership is expected to enhance customer retention for AT&T while driving new revenue streams for LifeMD.

: LifeMD has seen a substantial increase in weight management program subscribers, reaching approximately 108,000, driven by the popularity of GLP-1 therapies. This growth, combined with the introduction of new medications, positions LifeMD for sustained revenue growth and improved customer lifetime value.
